description: Administration of general economic and commercial affairs and services, including formulation and implementation of general economic and commercial policies; liaison with manufacturers, trade associations and other organizations interested in such matters; regulation or support of general economic and commercial activities such as export and import trade as a whole.
includes: administration of general economic and commercial affairs and services
formulation and implementation of general economic and commercial policies
liaison with manufacturers, trade associations and other organizations interested in economic and commercial affairs

regulation or support of general economic and commercial activities such as export and import trade as a whole, commodity and equity markets, capital controls, trade promotion, general regulation of monopolies and other restraints on trade and market entry
operation or support of patent, trademark and copyright offices, weather forecasting services, standards offices, hydrologic and geodetic surveys
